verdict.rationale: Dagster publishes a pricing page with at least one concrete tier (Solo Plan at $10/month with a 30-day free trial), so pricing is public. Nothing in the evidence explains how usage is metered or how adding a source changes cost. missing for 10: description of the billing unit (e.g., per-asset or per-run metering), per-source cost estimation guidance or calculator, details of higher tiers and overage rules, independent corroboration that costs are predictable.
